words.enDefinition: Food-related needs a meal should accommodate

examples.en: The event form asked for dietary requirements before we selected a meal.
examples.zh: 活动表单在我们选餐之前询问了「饮食要求」。

examples.en: I sent our dietary requirements to the organizer before the welcome dinner.
examples.zh: 迎新晚餐之前，我把大家的「饮食要求」发给了组织者。

words.enDefinition: A limit on what someone can or will eat

examples.en: The booking form let me describe a dietary restriction in my own words.
examples.zh: 预订表单允许我用自己的话说明一项「饮食限制」。

examples.en: I told the organizer about my dietary restriction before the group lunch.
examples.zh: 小组午餐前，我把自己的「饮食限制」告诉了组织者。

words.enDefinition: Difficulty digesting a food or one of its ingredients

examples.en: The lunch form had a separate box for describing a food intolerance.
examples.zh: 午餐表单上有个单独的框，用来说明「食物不耐受」情况。

examples.en: My housemate mentioned a food intolerance before we planned the shared menu.
examples.zh: 我们一起定菜单前，室友提到了自己的「食物不耐受」。

words.enDefinition: A substance that can trigger an allergic reaction

examples.en: The label highlighted the allergen in bold beside the name of the ingredient.
examples.zh: 标签在配料名称旁用粗体标出了「过敏原」。

examples.en: The dining team asked which allergen we wanted them to look up.
examples.zh: 餐厅工作人员问我们想让他们帮忙查哪一种「过敏原」。

words.enDefinition: Details about allergens in a product or dish

examples.en: I looked up the allergen information before choosing a sandwich at the café.
examples.zh: 选咖啡馆的三明治前，我查了「过敏原信息」。

examples.en: The server brought a separate folder with allergen information for the dessert menu.
examples.zh: 服务员拿来一个单独的文件夹，里面是甜点菜单的「过敏原信息」。

words.enDefinition: A table matching menu items to their allergens

examples.en: I checked the allergen matrix for the soup served at the student café.
examples.zh: 我查了「菜品过敏原对照表」，看学生咖啡馆卖的汤列了哪些过敏原。

examples.en: The allergen matrix had one row for each dish and a column for milk.
examples.zh: 「菜品过敏原对照表」每行是一道菜，其中一列是乳类。

words.enDefinition: Identification of allergens on a food label

examples.en: I found the allergen declaration below the list of ingredients on the packet.
examples.zh: 我在包装袋的配料表下方找到了「过敏原标示」。

examples.en: The allergen declaration on the new label listed milk and soy in bold.
examples.zh: 新标签的「过敏原标示」用粗体列出了乳类和大豆。

collocations: an allergen declaration on a label

words.enDefinition: A label statement identifying allergens present as ingredients

examples.en: The U.S. snack packet had a “Contains” statement in bold below the ingredients.
examples.zh: 美国那包零食在配料表下方用粗体印了「“含有”过敏原声明」。

examples.en: I read the “Contains” statement on the box before choosing a snack for the trip.
examples.zh: 为出行挑零食之前，我读了盒子上的「“含有”过敏原声明」。

collocations: a contains statement below the ingredients

words.enDefinition: A label phrase indicating something may be present

examples.en: The label says the biscuits may contain sesame, so I showed it to my roommate.
examples.zh: 标签写着饼干「可能含有」芝麻，所以我把包装给室友看了。

examples.en: I found the words may contain below the list of ingredients on the packet.
examples.zh: 我在包装的配料表下方找到了「可能含有」这几个字。

words.enDefinition: Very small quantities of a substance

examples.en: The packet said the chocolate might contain trace amounts of milk from shared equipment.
examples.zh: 包装说，巧克力可能因共用设备而含有「微量」乳类成分。

examples.en: I asked the café what trace amounts meant on the notice beside the muffins.
examples.zh: 我问咖啡馆，松饼旁边的告示上写的「微量」是什么意思。

words.enDefinition: Produced using machinery that handles other foods too

examples.en: The packet says the biscuits are made on shared equipment with products containing nuts.
examples.zh: 包装说，这些饼干和含坚果的产品「使用共用设备生产」。

examples.en: I asked what else was made on shared equipment at the bakery by campus.
examples.zh: 我问学校旁那家面包店，还有什么食品「使用同一套设备生产」。

collocations: made on shared equipment with other products
marked as made on shared equipment

words.enDefinition: A fryer used for more than one food

examples.en: I asked whether the café cooked the fries in a shared fryer.
examples.zh: 我问咖啡馆会不会用「共用炸锅」炸薯条。

examples.en: The shared fryer was mentioned in a note at the bottom of the menu.
examples.zh: 菜单底部的一条注释提到了「共用炸锅」。

words.enDefinition: Separate tools kept for different foods or people

examples.en: The server showed us which dishes had separate utensils on the buffet table.
examples.zh: 服务员给我们指出，自助餐台哪些菜品配了「分开使用的用具」。

examples.en: I asked whether the kitchen used separate utensils when preparing the two orders.
examples.zh: 我问厨房准备这两份餐时，会不会「分开使用用具」。

collocations: keep separate utensils for each dish

words.enDefinition: Unintended transfer of an allergen to another food

examples.en: The menu mentioned possible allergen cross-contact in the kitchen beside the ingredient details.
examples.zh: 菜单在配料说明旁提到了厨房里可能发生的「过敏原交叉接触」。

examples.en: I asked the dining manager about allergen cross-contact before choosing a meal that day.
examples.zh: 当天选餐前，我问了餐厅经理有关「过敏原交叉接触」的事。

words.enDefinition: Unintended transfer of contaminants between foods or surfaces

examples.en: The kitchen workshop discussed cross-contamination when foods touch the same board or counter.
examples.zh: 厨房工作坊讲到了食物接触同一块砧板或台面时的「交叉污染」。

examples.en: A notice in the shared kitchen explained why cross-contamination was a concern there.
examples.zh: 共用厨房的告示解释了为什么那里要留意「交叉污染」。

words.enDefinition: A card listing foods someone is allergic to

examples.en: My classmate showed a food allergy card to the staff before ordering lunch.
examples.zh: 同学点午餐之前，向店员出示了「食物过敏提示卡」。

examples.en: The food allergy card had the ingredients printed in English and Chinese.
examples.zh: 「食物过敏提示卡」用英文和中文印出了需要说明的配料。

words.enDefinition: A written note flagging an allergy for staff

examples.en: The café put an allergy note on the order before sending it through.
examples.zh: 咖啡馆在把订单发过去之前，加了一条「过敏备注」。

examples.en: I checked that the allergy note included sesame before the form was submitted.
examples.zh: 表单提交前，我确认「过敏备注」里写了芝麻。

collocations: an allergy note on an order

words.enDefinition: To check exactly what a dish contains

examples.en: The server went back to confirm the ingredients in the salad dressing.
examples.zh: 服务员回厨房「确认了沙拉酱的配料」。

examples.en: Could you confirm the ingredients in this soup before I choose a main dish?
examples.zh: 我选主菜之前，你能「确认一下这碗汤的配料」吗？

collocations: ask someone to confirm the ingredients
confirm the ingredients with the cook

words.enDefinition: To ask kitchen staff to verify something

examples.en: Could you check with the kitchen whether the dressing contains any sesame oil?
examples.zh: 能请你「向厨房核实」一下沙拉酱里有没有芝麻油吗？

examples.en: I asked the server to check with the kitchen rather than guess about the sauce.
examples.zh: 我请服务员「向厨房核实」酱汁的配料。

collocations: ask someone to check with the kitchen
go and check with the kitchen
check with the kitchen about an ingredient

words.enDefinition: The use of one ingredient in place of another

examples.en: I asked whether the ingredient substitution had changed the allergen information for the dish.
examples.zh: 我问「配料替换」是否改变了这道菜的过敏原信息。

examples.en: The dining team explained why an ingredient substitution wasn't possible for that sauce.
examples.zh: 餐厅工作人员解释了为什么那种酱汁不能做「配料替换」。

collocations: an ingredient substitution on the menu

words.enDefinition: An area reserved for preparing particular foods

examples.en: The dining manager showed us the dedicated prep area during the kitchen tour.
examples.zh: 参观厨房时，餐厅经理给我们看了「专用备料区」。

examples.en: I asked which dishes were made in the dedicated prep area at the café.
examples.zh: 我问咖啡馆哪些菜是在「专用备料区」做的。

collocations: set up a dedicated prep area
a dedicated prep area in the kitchen

words.enDefinition: A question used to ask if something is present

examples.en: Does this contain any milk powder, or should I check the label on the packet?
examples.zh: 「这个含有奶粉吗」，要不我看一下包装上的标签？

examples.en: Does this contain sesame, even though it isn't mentioned in the name of the dish?
examples.zh: 菜名里虽然没提到芝麻，「这个含有芝麻吗」？

words.enDefinition: A question about whether food is prepared apart

examples.en: Is it prepared separately from the dishes that have peanuts in the sauce?
examples.zh: 「这道菜是和酱里含花生的那些菜分开做的吗」？

examples.en: I asked, “Is it prepared separately?” before choosing a dish from the buffet.
examples.zh: 从自助餐里选菜前，我问：「这道菜是分开做的吗？」

collocations: check by asking “Is it prepared separately?”

words.enDefinition: Asking if a dish can omit an ingredient

examples.en: Can you make it without butter, or is the sauce already prepared?
examples.zh: 「可以不放黄油做吗」，还是酱汁已经调好了？

examples.en: Can you make it without sesame oil for the group meal this evening?
examples.zh: 今晚聚餐的这道菜，「可以不放芝麻油做吗」？

collocations: can you make it without butter
can you make it without eggs
can you make it without sesame

words.enDefinition: An edible nut from a tree, such as a walnut

examples.en: I checked which tree nut was listed in bold on the chocolate wrapper.
examples.zh: 我查看了巧克力包装上用粗体标出的是哪种「树坚果」。

examples.en: The menu named each tree nut used in the café's cakes and pastries.
examples.zh: 菜单逐一列出了咖啡馆蛋糕和糕点中用到的各种「树坚果」。

words.enDefinition: An edible seed that grows in a pod underground

examples.en: The sauce label listed peanuts among the ingredients below the picture.
examples.zh: 酱汁标签在图片下方的配料表里列出了「花生」。

examples.en: I asked whether the peanut topping was already mixed into the salad.
examples.zh: 我问当浇头的「花生」是不是已经拌进了沙拉。

words.enDefinition: Small oil-rich seeds used to flavour food

examples.en: I looked for sesame on the label at the small shop near campus.
examples.zh: 我在学校附近的小店查看标签上有没有「芝麻」。

examples.en: The server checked whether the bread had sesame on top or inside.
examples.zh: 服务员查了面包上的「芝麻」是撒在表面还是加在里面。

words.enDefinition: Edible crustaceans and molluscs, such as prawns and mussels

examples.en: The menu used shellfish for dishes containing prawns, mussels or both at the café.
examples.zh: 咖啡馆菜单把含虾、贻贝或两者都有的菜标为「甲壳及软体类水产」。

examples.en: I asked the server which soups contained shellfish before we ordered at the counter.
examples.zh: 我们在柜台点餐前，我问服务员哪些汤含「甲壳及软体类水产」。

words.enDefinition: An aquatic animal with a hard outer covering

examples.en: The menu named prawn as the crustacean used in the cold noodle dish.
examples.zh: 菜单写明这道凉面用到的「甲壳类水产」是虾。

examples.en: I looked up which crustacean the label meant before buying the prepared soup.
examples.zh: 买现成的汤之前，我查了标签指的是哪种「甲壳类水产」。

words.enDefinition: A soft-bodied animal such as a mussel or squid

examples.en: I asked which mollusc was included in the seafood mix on the menu.
examples.zh: 我问菜单上的海鲜拼盘里包括哪种「软体类水产」。

examples.en: The course handout used a mussel as an example of a mollusc.
examples.zh: 课程讲义用贻贝作为「软体类水产」的例子。

words.enDefinition: A cereal crop used to make flour

examples.en: I checked whether wheat was listed on the back of the cracker packet.
examples.zh: 我查看了饼干包装背面有没有列「小麦」。

examples.en: The label mentioned wheat even though the front of the packet only showed oats.
examples.zh: 包装正面只画了燕麦，可标签里提到了「小麦」。

words.enDefinition: Proteins found in wheat and certain other grains

examples.en: The handout explained where gluten was listed on the food labels we read.
examples.zh: 讲义解释了「麸质」在我们阅读的食品标签上标在哪里。

examples.en: I checked the menu for a note about gluten before choosing the soup.
examples.zh: 选汤之前，我看了菜单上有没有关于「麸质」的说明。

words.enDefinition: Protein naturally found in milk

examples.en: The label listed milk protein separately from sugar on the powdered drink packet.
examples.zh: 饮料粉包装把「乳蛋白」和糖分开列出。

examples.en: I checked whether the new recipe still included milk protein before buying the biscuits.
examples.zh: 买饼干前，我核对了新配方是否仍含「乳蛋白」。

words.enDefinition: A legume whose seeds are processed into food ingredients

examples.en: I first saw lupin listed as an ingredient on a packet in England.
examples.zh: 我第一次看到配料表中列出「羽扇豆」，是在英格兰。

examples.en: The ingredient guide explained why lupin appeared in the flour blend for these rolls.
examples.zh: 配料说明解释了为什么做这些餐包的混合面粉里有「羽扇豆」。

words.enDefinition: Compounds sometimes used to preserve foods and drinks

examples.en: I saw sulphites listed among the ingredients on the dried fruit packet.
examples.zh: 我看到果干包装的配料表上有「亚硫酸盐」。

examples.en: The dining card showed sulphites in a separate column for this particular menu.
examples.zh: 这份菜单专用的餐饮卡片给「亚硫酸盐」单列了一栏。

words.enDefinition: Food or seasoning made from mustard plant seeds

examples.en: I asked whether mustard was already mixed into the dressing for the salad.
examples.zh: 我问沙拉酱里是不是已经加了「芥末类配料」。

examples.en: The ingredient label listed mustard in bold on the jar of pickle relish.
examples.zh: 酸黄瓜酱罐子的配料标签用粗体列出了「芥末类配料」。

words.enDefinition: Soybean-derived food used in other products

examples.en: The label listed soy alongside milk in the note below the ingredients.
examples.zh: 标签在配料表下的说明里，把「大豆成分」和乳类列在一起。

examples.en: I asked whether the sauce contained soy before checking the menu for other options.
examples.zh: 我先问酱汁是不是含「大豆成分」，再看菜单上有没有别的选择。

words.enDefinition: The liquid left after milk forms curds

examples.en: I saw whey on the cracker label and checked the other ingredients.
examples.zh: 我在饼干标签上看到「乳清」，又查看了其他配料。

examples.en: My classmate pointed out where whey was printed on the milk chocolate wrapper.
examples.zh: 同学指给我看牛奶巧克力包装上哪里印着「乳清」。

words.enDefinition: Described as not containing wheat

examples.en: The shelf label said wheat-free, but I still wanted to read the full ingredients.
examples.zh: 货架上标着「不含小麦」，不过我还是想看完整配料表。

examples.en: I checked the menu to see which crackers were labelled wheat-free that afternoon.
examples.zh: 那天下午，我查看了菜单上哪些饼干标着「不含小麦」。

words.enDefinition: Described as not containing peanuts

examples.en: The label said peanut-free, and my friend checked the rest of the packet too.
examples.zh: 标签写着「不含花生」，我朋友也看了包装的其他地方。

examples.en: I asked which snack bars were labelled peanut-free in the campus shop.
examples.zh: 我问学校商店里哪些零食棒标着「不含花生」。

words.enDefinition: Described as not containing sesame

examples.en: I looked for a sesame-free option on the prepacked lunch menu at the café.
examples.zh: 我在咖啡馆的预包装午餐菜单里找「不含芝麻的」选项。

examples.en: The sesame-free label was on one variety rather than on the entire shelf.
examples.zh: 「不含芝麻」的标签贴在一个品种上，没有贴在整层货架上。

words.enDefinition: Described as not containing eggs

examples.en: The bakery marked one tray of rolls egg-free on the display card.
examples.zh: 面包房在一盘餐包的展示卡上写着「不含鸡蛋」。

examples.en: I compared two egg-free recipes before shopping for the weekend bake sale.
examples.zh: 为周末义卖采购前，我比较了两份「不含鸡蛋的」食谱。

words.enDefinition: Described as not containing soy

examples.en: The café had one soy-free dressing listed in the folder beside the menu.
examples.zh: 咖啡馆在菜单旁的文件夹里列了一种「不含大豆的」沙拉酱。

examples.en: I asked whether the soy-free label belonged to this packet or the one beside it.
examples.zh: 我问「不含大豆」的标签是贴这包的，还是旁边那包的。

words.zhGloss: 不含甲壳及软体类水产的
words.enDefinition: Described as not containing shellfish
acceptedZhAnswers: 不含甲壳及软体类水产的

examples.en: I asked the dining team which dishes were described as shellfish-free on their menu.
examples.zh: 我问餐厅工作人员，菜单上哪些菜标为「不含甲壳及软体类水产」。

examples.en: The chef showed me where shellfish-free appeared in the list of meal options.
examples.zh: 厨师指给我看菜单选项中哪里标着「不含甲壳及软体类水产」。

words.enDefinition: Labelled as free of lactose, a milk sugar

examples.en: I bought lactose-free milk after my roommate pointed out the shelf label.
examples.zh: 室友指给我看货架标签后，我买了「不含乳糖的」牛奶。

examples.en: The café's menu listed lactose-free milk in a note under the hot drinks.
examples.zh: 咖啡馆在热饮下的注释里列出了「不含乳糖的」牛奶。

words.enDefinition: Containing gluten or ingredients made with it

examples.en: The course handout asked us to underline gluten-containing grains on each sample label.
examples.zh: 课程讲义让我们在每个标签样本上给「含麸质的」谷物画下划线。

examples.en: The dining guide grouped gluten-containing dishes together for students choosing meals in advance.
examples.zh: 餐厅指南把「含麸质的」菜集中列出，方便学生提前选餐。

words.enDefinition: A question about whether broth contains meat or fish

examples.en: I asked, “Is the broth vegetarian?” before choosing the noodle soup with mushrooms.
examples.zh: 我选蘑菇汤面前问：「汤底是素的吗？」

examples.en: Is the broth vegetarian, or does it contain chicken stock from the kitchen?
examples.zh: 「汤底是素的吗」，还是厨房在里面加了鸡高汤？

collocations: “Is the broth vegetarian or made with chicken stock?”

words.enDefinition: A vegetarian who eats both dairy and eggs

examples.en: The welcome dinner form let me specify that I was a lacto-ovo vegetarian.
examples.zh: 迎新晚餐的表单允许我注明自己是「蛋奶素食者」。

examples.en: My classmate described herself as a lacto-ovo vegetarian when we planned the group lunch.
examples.zh: 我们筹划小组午餐时，同学说自己是「蛋奶素食者」。

words.enDefinition: Permitted under Islamic dietary rules

examples.en: I asked which meals were halal before sending our group order to the café.
examples.zh: 把团体订单发给咖啡馆之前，我问了哪些餐点「符合清真饮食要求」。

examples.en: The dinner form had a separate tick box for halal meals at the event.
examples.zh: 晚餐表单有个可单独勾选的框，用来选择活动上的「清真餐」。

words.enDefinition: Certified by an organization as meeting halal standards

examples.en: The caterer listed two halal-certified meals on the form for the campus dinner.
examples.zh: 餐饮供应商在学校晚餐的表单上列了两份「经清真认证的」餐食。

examples.en: I checked whether the halal-certified label applied to the sauce as well as the main dish.
examples.zh: 我查看了「经清真认证」的标签是不是也适用于酱汁和主菜。

words.zhGloss: 符合犹太教饮食要求的
words.enDefinition: Permitted under Jewish dietary rules
acceptedZhAnswers: 符合犹太教饮食要求的

examples.en: I asked whether a kosher meal could be ordered for the campus welcome dinner.
examples.zh: 我问学校的迎新晚餐能不能订一份「符合犹太教饮食要求的」餐点。

examples.en: The dinner organizer noted the kosher request beside the name on the list.
examples.zh: 晚餐组织者在名单姓名旁记下了「犹太教饮食要求」。

words.enDefinition: A mark used to indicate kosher certification

examples.en: I looked for a kosher symbol beside the ingredients on the snack packet.
examples.zh: 我查看零食包装的配料表旁有没有「犹太洁食认证标志」。

examples.en: The website showed the kosher symbol printed on each pack from this supplier.
examples.zh: 网站展示了这家供应商每个包装上印的「犹太洁食认证标志」。

collocations: a kosher symbol on the package

words.enDefinition: Described as made without pork

examples.en: I checked which noodle soups were marked pork-free on the menu at lunch.
examples.zh: 午餐时，我看了菜单上哪些汤面标着「不含猪肉」。

examples.en: The caterer offered a pork-free version of the dish for our student event.
examples.zh: 餐饮供应商为我们的学生活动提供了这道菜「不含猪肉的」版本。

words.enDefinition: A phrase stating that alcohol is present

examples.en: The dessert menu said the sauce contains alcohol and marked it separately.
examples.zh: 甜点菜单写明那种酱汁「含有酒精」，并单独作了标记。

examples.en: I asked whether the note saying contains alcohol referred to the whole dessert.
examples.zh: 我问写着「含有酒精」的说明是不是指整份甜点。

collocations: a warning that a dish contains alcohol

words.enDefinition: An ingredient that comes from an animal

examples.en: I asked the server to check whether the glaze used an animal-derived ingredient.
examples.zh: 我请服务员查看外层糖衣是否用了「动物来源配料」。

examples.en: The guide listed gelatin as an example of an animal-derived ingredient on food labels.
examples.zh: 指南把明胶列为食品标签上「动物来源配料」的一个例子。

collocations: an animal-derived ingredient in a recipe

words.enDefinition: An animal-derived substance used to set or thicken food

examples.en: I checked for gelatin before buying the dessert for our student group's lunch.
examples.zh: 我为学生小组的午餐买甜点前，查看了有没有「明胶」。

examples.en: The packet listed gelatin among the ingredients for the fruit sweets inside.
examples.zh: 包装在里面那些水果软糖的配料表中列出了「明胶」。

words.enDefinition: Enzymes from animals used to make milk set

examples.en: I asked whether the cheese in the sandwich was made with animal rennet.
examples.zh: 我问三明治里的奶酪是不是用「动物凝乳酶」做的。

examples.en: The menu note identified the cheeses that the supplier made using animal rennet.
examples.zh: 菜单注释标出了供应商用「动物凝乳酶」制作的几种奶酪。

words.enDefinition: Rendered pig fat used in cooking

examples.en: I asked whether the pastry contained lard before ordering it for the meeting.
examples.zh: 我问了糕点是否含「猪油」，再决定要不要给会议订。

examples.en: The guide listed lard as an ingredient in one version of the pastry.
examples.zh: 指南把「猪油」列在其中一种糕点的配料表里。

words.enDefinition: The solid components of milk after removing water

examples.en: The packet listed milk solids in bold under the name of the biscuit.
examples.zh: 饼干名称下方的包装上用粗体列了「乳固形物」。

examples.en: I asked the café where milk solids appeared in the supplier's ingredient information.
examples.zh: 我问咖啡馆，供应商的配料说明在哪儿列了「乳固形物」。

words.enDefinition: A protein found naturally in milk

examples.en: I found casein on the label while checking the ingredients for our group lunch.
examples.zh: 我为小组午餐查配料时，在标签上看到了「酪蛋白」。

examples.en: The class handout identified casein as one of the proteins found in milk.
examples.zh: 课堂讲义介绍，「酪蛋白」是乳类中所含的蛋白质之一。

words.enDefinition: A soy-derived ingredient used to help mixtures stay blended

examples.en: I found soy lecithin in the list printed inside the box flap.
examples.zh: 我在盒盖内侧印的清单里看到了「大豆卵磷脂」。

examples.en: Both chocolate bars listed soy lecithin, but the wrappers displayed it in different places.
examples.zh: 两种巧克力棒都列了「大豆卵磷脂」，但印在包装上的位置不同。

words.enDefinition: Barley allowed to sprout and then dried

examples.en: The cereal box listed barley malt after the first three ingredients on its label.
examples.zh: 谷物食品盒上的标签在前三项配料后列出了「大麦麦芽」。

examples.en: My flatmate spotted barley malt on one cracker packet but not the other.
examples.zh: 室友在一包饼干上看到了「大麦麦芽」，另一包上没有。

words.enDefinition: A label saying sugar was not added

examples.en: The label said no added sugar below the picture of the fruit.
examples.zh: 标签在水果图案下方写着「无添加糖」。

examples.en: I compared the drinks after noticing that one carton said no added sugar.
examples.zh: 我注意到一个饮料盒上写着「无添加糖」，就对比了一下这几种饮料。

collocations: no added sugar on the label
a drink with no added sugar

words.enDefinition: Prepared without adding sugar or other sweeteners

examples.en: I bought an unsweetened version of the drink from the shop near campus.
examples.zh: 我在学校附近的店买了这种饮料「未加甜味剂的」版本。

examples.en: The dispenser offered unsweetened tea in a separate jug beside the sweetened one.
examples.zh: 供饮处把「未加甜味剂的」茶单独放在一个壶里，旁边是甜茶。

words.enDefinition: Salt put into food during preparation or processing

examples.en: The package used bold letters to state that there was no added salt.
examples.zh: 包装用粗体标出没有「添加的盐」。

examples.en: I asked whether the beans had any added salt before buying a tin.
examples.zh: 买罐头前，我问这些豆子有没有「加盐」。

words.enDefinition: Starch extracted from wheat grains

examples.en: The sandwich label listed wheat starch in the ingredients for the sauce.
examples.zh: 三明治标签上，酱汁的配料里列了「小麦淀粉」。

examples.en: I asked which part of the meal contained wheat starch before choosing another dish.
examples.zh: 我问餐点的哪一部分含「小麦淀粉」，再决定选另一道菜。

collocations: a sauce thickened with wheat starch

words.enDefinition: Milk-setting enzymes made using microorganisms

examples.en: I looked for microbial rennet on the cheese packet at the campus shop.
examples.zh: 我在学校商店查看奶酪包装上有没有标「微生物凝乳酶」。

examples.en: The cheese label listed microbial rennet in a line beneath the main ingredients.
examples.zh: 奶酪标签在主要配料下方一行列出了「微生物凝乳酶」。

words.enDefinition: Still sealed as packaged by the manufacturer

examples.en: The salesperson showed me a factory-sealed jar from the same delivery at the shop.
examples.zh: 店员给我看了同一批到货的一个「原厂封装的」玻璃罐。

examples.en: I wrote factory-sealed beside the jars we had not opened for the cooking class.
examples.zh: 我在烹饪课还没开过的几个罐子旁标了「原厂封装」。

words.enDefinition: A seal that has not been broken

examples.en: I noticed the intact seal below the lid when I picked up the tub.
examples.zh: 我拿起盒子时，看到盖子下面有「完好的封口」。

examples.en: The volunteer asked which jars still had an intact seal at the food stall.
examples.zh: 志愿者在食品摊上问哪些罐子还有「完好的封口」。

collocations: a jar with an intact seal
an intact seal under the cap

words.enDefinition: A seal that is no longer closed or intact

examples.en: I noticed a broken seal after lifting the lid on the carton.
examples.zh: 打开纸盒盖后，我看到了一个「破损的封口」。

examples.en: I mentioned the broken seal when I returned the container to the campus shop.
examples.zh: 我把盒子退回学校商店时，提到了「破损的封口」。

collocations: a product with a broken seal

words.enDefinition: A food can with part of its surface pushed in

examples.en: The cashier noticed a dented can among the tins in my shopping basket.
examples.zh: 收银员注意到我购物篮里有一个「有凹痕的罐头」。

examples.en: I pointed out the dented can to the person sorting the food donations.
examples.zh: 我把那个「有凹痕的罐头」指给整理捐赠食品的人看。

words.enDefinition: A lid that curves outward abnormally

examples.en: I showed the volunteer the bulging lid on a jar in the delivery box.
examples.zh: 我把送货箱里一只罐子上「鼓起的盖子」指给志愿者看。

examples.en: The shop assistant took away the tub with a bulging lid from the shelf.
examples.zh: 店员把有「鼓起的盖子」的那个盒子从货架上拿走了。

collocations: a jar with a bulging lid

words.enDefinition: Printed information identifying and describing a food product

examples.en: I turned the carton around so I could read the food label properly.
examples.zh: 我把纸盒转过来，好仔细看「食品标签」。

examples.en: Our class compared the food label on a jar with the one on its box.
examples.zh: 我们班对比了罐子上的「食品标签」和外包装盒上的标签。

words.enDefinition: Date information printed or stamped on food packaging

examples.en: The worksheet explained date marking using examples from two products in the campus shop.
examples.zh: 练习单用学校商店两种食品作例子解释了「日期标示」。

examples.en: I found the date marking close to the fold at the bottom of the packet.
examples.zh: 我在包装袋底部靠近折边的地方找到了「日期标示」。

collocations: a date marking on the package

words.enDefinition: The day food was placed in its packaging

examples.en: The label gave a packing date below the name of the fruit supplier.
examples.zh: 标签在水果供应商名称下方写明了「包装日期」。

examples.en: I checked the packing date before sorting two boxes in the shared kitchen.
examples.zh: 整理共用厨房里的两盒食品前，我看了「包装日期」。

collocations: a packing date on the label

words.enDefinition: The day a food product was made

examples.en: The production date was stamped at the bottom of the tin near the batch code.
examples.zh: 「生产日期」打在罐底，靠近批次编码。

examples.en: I asked the assistant whether the number near the lid was the production date.
examples.zh: 我问店员，盖子旁的那串数字是不是「生产日期」。

words.zhGloss: 安全食用截止日期（英国）
words.enDefinition: A UK food label date concerning safe use
acceptedZhAnswers: 安全食用截止日期（英国）

examples.en: I checked the use-by date on the sandwich I bought at the London station.
examples.zh: 我查看了在伦敦车站买的三明治的「安全食用截止日期」。

examples.en: The UK package printed the use-by date next to the note about refrigeration.
examples.zh: 英国的食品包装把「安全食用截止日期」印在冷藏说明旁边。

words.enDefinition: A label date indicating expected best food quality

examples.en: The best-before date was printed on the lid of the oats I bought.
examples.zh: 我买的燕麦在盖子上印了「最佳食用品质日期」。

examples.en: I checked the best-before date because two similar bags had different labels.
examples.zh: 两袋食品看起来相似但标签不同，所以我看了「最佳食用品质日期」。

collocations: a best-before date on the lid

words.zhGloss: 零售陈列截止日期（美国）
words.enDefinition: A retail date marking the end of display for sale
acceptedZhAnswers: 零售陈列截止日期（美国）

examples.en: The U.S. supermarket printed a sell-by date next to the barcode on this pack.
examples.zh: 这家美国超市把「零售陈列截止日期」印在了这个包装的条形码旁。

examples.en: I noticed a sell-by date on the U.S. carton when we compared sample labels.
examples.zh: 比较标签样本时，我注意到美国那个纸盒上印着「零售陈列截止日期」。

collocations: a sell-by date for stock rotation

words.zhGloss: 建议最晚冷冻日期（美国）
words.enDefinition: Recommended last date to freeze for best quality
acceptedZhAnswers: 建议最晚冷冻日期（美国）

examples.en: I saw a freeze-by date printed beside the label on a U.S. food carton.
examples.zh: 我看到一个美国食品盒的标签旁印着「建议最晚冷冻日期」。

examples.en: The worksheet asked us to find the freeze-by date on the American sample package.
examples.zh: 练习单让我们找出美国包装样本上的「建议最晚冷冻日期」。

collocations: a freeze-by date on the box

words.enDefinition: A set of printed characters representing a date

examples.en: I found a date code next to the seam of the bag.
examples.zh: 我在包装袋接缝旁找到了一串「日期编码」。

examples.en: The assistant explained which part of the date code identified the month.
examples.zh: 店员解释了「日期编码」里的哪部分代表月份。

words.enDefinition: A label code identifying one production batch

examples.en: I wrote down the batch code from the bottom of the tin.
examples.zh: 我记下了罐底的「批次编码」。

examples.en: The store asked for the batch code when I reported a problem with the lid.
examples.zh: 我反映盖子有问题时，商店要我提供「批次编码」。

words.enDefinition: Near its best-before or use-by date

examples.en: The British supermarket set out short-dated items on a shelf beside the checkout.
examples.zh: 这家英国超市把「临近食用标示日期的」食品摆在收银台旁的货架上。

examples.en: I asked what short-dated meant on the label for the packaged sandwiches.
examples.zh: 我问包装三明治的标签上写的「临近食用标示日期」是什么意思。

words.enDefinition: Past a labelled best-before or use-by date

examples.en: We found some tins marked out of date while checking the shared cupboard.
examples.zh: 我们查看共用食品柜时，发现几罐标记为「已过标示日期」的食品。

examples.en: I asked which date the volunteer meant when she said the packet was out of date.
examples.zh: 志愿者说那包食品「已过标示日期」时，我问她指的是哪个日期。

collocations: check whether food is out of date
mark a packet as out of date

words.enDefinition: A label instruction to keep food in a refrigerator

examples.en: The words keep refrigerated were printed on the side of the juice bottle.
examples.zh: 果汁瓶侧面印着「请冷藏保存」。

examples.en: I turned the carton to check which side said keep refrigerated before unpacking the groceries.
examples.zh: 拆开买的东西前，我转了转纸盒，看看哪一面写着「请冷藏保存」。

words.enDefinition: A label instruction to chill food once opened

examples.en: The sauce bottle said refrigerate after opening in small letters beneath the ingredients.
examples.zh: 酱汁瓶在配料下方用小字写着「开封后冷藏」。

examples.en: We found the words refrigerate after opening when we compared the labels in class.
examples.zh: 课堂上对比标签时，我们找到了「开封后冷藏」这几个字。

collocations: a label saying refrigerate after opening

words.enDefinition: A label instruction to store food frozen

examples.en: The packet of berries had the words keep frozen printed near the fold.
examples.zh: 莓果包装靠近折边的位置印着「请冷冻保存」。

examples.en: I found keep frozen below the picture on the side of the pizza box.
examples.zh: 我在披萨盒侧面图片的下方找到了「请冷冻保存」。

words.enDefinition: A label instruction against freezing thawed food again

examples.en: The packet said do not refreeze in the line beneath the storage instructions.
examples.zh: 包装袋在储存说明下一行写着「请勿再次冷冻」。

examples.en: I had to turn the box around to find the words do not refreeze.
examples.zh: 我得把盒子转过去，才能找到「请勿再次冷冻」这几个字。

collocations: a label saying do not refreeze

words.expression: store in a cool dry place
words.lemma: store in a cool dry place
words.enDefinition: A label instruction to avoid heat and moisture
acceptedEnVariants: store in a cool dry place
keep in a cool dry place

examples.en: The tea tin said to store in a cool dry place near the barcode.
examples.zh: 茶叶罐在条形码旁写着「存放在阴凉干燥处」。

examples.en: I copied the words store in a cool dry place from a sample packet in class.
examples.zh: 我在课堂上从包装样本上抄下了「存放在阴凉干燥处」这句话。

collocations: a label saying store in a cool dry place
products marked store in a cool dry place
store in a cool dry place away from sunlight

words.enDefinition: From the time the package has been opened

examples.en: The label gave different instructions for the jar once opened than for an unopened jar.
examples.zh: 标签给罐子「开封后」和未开封时列了不同的储存说明。

examples.en: The bottle had a second line of information beginning with the words once opened.
examples.zh: 瓶子的第二行说明以「开封后」开头。

collocations: instructions for a product once opened

words.enDefinition: A label phrase giving a period for using something

examples.en: I looked for the words use within on the note below the lid.
examples.zh: 我在盖子下方的说明上找「须在所示期限内用完」的提示。

examples.en: The cooking class worksheet asked us to find the use within instruction on each carton.
examples.zh: 烹饪课的练习单让我们找出每个纸盒上「须在所示期限内用完」的说明。

collocations: a label beginning with use within

words.enDefinition: A direction to keep a container standing vertically

examples.en: The words store upright were printed on a removable sticker beside the handle.
examples.zh: 「竖直存放」印在提手旁一张可撕下的贴纸上。

examples.en: I saw that the label said store upright when my flatmate unpacked the bottle.
examples.zh: 室友把瓶子从袋里拿出来时，我看到标签写着「竖直存放」。

words.enDefinition: Out of a place where sunlight shines directly

examples.en: The carton said to keep it away from direct sunlight once it was opened.
examples.zh: 纸盒写明，开封后要「避免阳光直射」。

examples.en: I found away from direct sunlight in the small print beneath the barcode.
examples.zh: 我在条形码下面的小字里找到了「避免阳光直射」。

words.enDefinition: The package in which a product was supplied

examples.en: I photographed the original packaging so my roommate could see which biscuits I meant.
examples.zh: 我拍下「原包装」，这样室友就知道我说的是哪种饼干。

examples.en: The label was easier to read on the original packaging than in the photo I had taken.
examples.zh: 「原包装」上的标签比我拍的照片更容易看清。

words.enDefinition: Able to be stored unopened without refrigeration

examples.en: The campus pantry kept shelf-stable cartons on a different shelf from fresh deliveries.
examples.zh: 学校食品救济站把「可常温储存的」盒装食品和新到的生鲜分开摆放。

examples.en: I checked which drinks were described as shelf-stable before helping to arrange the shelves.
examples.zh: 帮忙整理货架前，我查看了哪些饮料标为「可常温储存」。

words.enDefinition: Food liable to deteriorate relatively quickly

examples.en: The student event team asked which deliveries contained perishable food that afternoon.
examples.zh: 学生活动小组询问当天下午送到的东西里哪些属于「易腐食品」。

examples.en: The cupboard sign asked people not to leave perishable food on its shelves.
examples.zh: 食品柜上的牌子请大家不要在架上放「易腐食品」。

words.enDefinition: Keeping food in a cupboard at room temperature

examples.en: The label gave separate notes for pantry storage and storage after opening.
examples.zh: 标签把「食品柜常温储存」和开封后储存的说明分开列出。

examples.en: The shared kitchen uses the tall cupboard for pantry storage next to the fridge.
examples.zh: 共用厨房用冰箱旁的高柜做「食品柜常温储存」用。

words.enDefinition: Keeping food at a low temperature without freezing it

examples.en: The sheet marked which lunch deliveries needed chilled storage before the event.
examples.zh: 清单标出了活动前哪些送到的午餐需要「冷藏储存」。

examples.en: I asked the coordinator where the hall had space for chilled storage.
examples.zh: 我问协调员大厅里哪里有可以「冷藏储存」的地方。

words.enDefinition: Keeping food in a freezer

examples.en: The packet included different dates for pantry storage and freezer storage.
examples.zh: 包装上分别标出了食品柜常温储存和「冷冻储存」的日期。

examples.en: My flatmates asked how much space we had available for freezer storage.
examples.zh: 室友问我们还有多大空间可以用来「冷冻储存」。

words.enDefinition: A container that prevents air passing through its seal

examples.en: I labelled the airtight container so my flatmates knew which rice was mine.
examples.zh: 我给「密封容器」贴了标签，这样室友就知道哪份米饭是我的。

examples.en: The airtight container was on the top shelf beside the unopened packet.
examples.zh: 「密封容器」在最上层，旁边是没开封的食品包。

collocations: an airtight container with a lid
store food in an airtight container

words.enDefinition: A bag that can be closed again after opening

examples.en: The frozen berries came in a resealable bag with a strip across the top.
examples.zh: 冷冻莓果装在「可反复封口的袋子」里，袋口有一条封口条。

examples.en: I checked whether the crackers came in a resealable bag before buying them.
examples.zh: 买饼干之前，我看了看是不是装在「可反复封口的袋子」里。

collocations: a resealable bag with a zip

words.enDefinition: A bag designed for storing food in the freezer

examples.en: I wrote the contents on the freezer bag before putting it in our drawer.
examples.zh: 我先在「冷冻保鲜袋」上写明装的是什么，再把它放进冷冻抽屉。

examples.en: My roommate asked for a freezer bag from the box near the sink.
examples.zh: 室友让我从洗手池旁边的盒子里拿一个「冷冻保鲜袋」。

words.enDefinition: A container designed to sit securely on another

examples.en: I bought a stackable container that fits on the shallow shelf in our fridge.
examples.zh: 我买了一个「可叠放的容器」，能放进我们冰箱的浅层搁板。

examples.en: The stackable container left enough room for my flatmate's groceries on the same shelf.
examples.zh: 这个「可叠放的容器」在同一层架子上给室友的食品留出了足够的空间。

collocations: a stackable container with a lid

words.enDefinition: Suitable for use in a household freezer

examples.en: The label said the small container was freezer-safe and showed a snowflake symbol.
examples.zh: 标签写明这个小盒子「适合冷冻使用」，还画了一个雪花符号。

examples.en: I checked whether the lids were freezer-safe before choosing a set for the flat.
examples.zh: 给公寓挑一套盒子前，我查看了盒盖是不是也「适合冷冻使用」。

words.enDefinition: A container designed to stop liquid escaping

examples.en: I packed the dressing in a leakproof container before putting it in my bag.
examples.zh: 我先把沙拉酱装进「防漏容器」，再放进包里。

examples.en: My flatmate lent me a leakproof container for the soup left after dinner.
examples.zh: 室友借给我一个「防漏容器」，用来装晚饭剩下的汤。

collocations: pack soup in a leakproof container

words.enDefinition: A lid that clicks into place when pushed

examples.en: The box had a snap-on lid that clicked when I pressed the sides.
examples.zh: 盒子有个「按扣式盒盖」，我按两侧时听到了咔哒声。

examples.en: I found the snap-on lid for my lunch container behind the larger ones.
examples.zh: 我在较大的那些盒盖后面找到了午餐盒的「按扣式盒盖」。

collocations: a container with a snap-on lid

words.enDefinition: A container with a lid or covering over it

examples.en: The café put the spare rolls in a covered container under the counter.
examples.zh: 咖啡馆把多出来的餐包放在柜台下的「有盖容器」里。

examples.en: I brought the biscuits to the meeting in a covered container from home.
examples.zh: 我用家里拿来的「有盖容器」把饼干带到了会议上。

collocations: store something in a covered container
a covered container on the counter

words.enDefinition: A flexible wax-coated cloth used to wrap food

examples.en: I saw beeswax wrap beside the sandwich bags at the student market.
examples.zh: 我在学生市集的三明治袋旁看到了「蜂蜡保鲜布」。

examples.en: My roommate used a piece of beeswax wrap to cover the bread for lunch.
examples.zh: 室友用一块「蜂蜡保鲜布」把午餐的面包包起来了。

words.enDefinition: To write the date on stored leftover food

examples.en: My flatmate asked me to date the leftovers before we cleared the counter.
examples.zh: 我们收拾台面前，室友让我「给剩菜标注日期」。

examples.en: I used a blank sticker to date the leftovers from our group dinner.
examples.zh: 我用一张空白贴纸「给聚餐剩下的菜标注日期」。

collocations: use a sticker to date the leftovers
date the leftovers before storing them

words.enDefinition: To mark a container with identifying information

examples.en: I borrowed a marker to label the container with my name before dinner.
examples.zh: 晚饭前，我借了支记号笔，「在容器上标了我的名字」。

examples.en: My roommate asked whether we could label the container before putting it away.
examples.zh: 室友问我们能不能在把盒子收起来前先「给容器贴标签」。

collocations: label the container with a date
use a sticker to label the container

words.enDefinition: A label introducing the date a package was opened

examples.en: I wrote opened on above the date on the sticker for our shared jar.
examples.zh: 我在共用罐子的贴纸上，日期上方写了「开封日期」。

examples.en: The jar had a label saying opened on followed by a handwritten date.
examples.zh: 罐子上有张标签写着「开封日期」，后面是手写的日期。

collocations: write opened on beside the date

words.enDefinition: To use earlier stock before the newer items

examples.en: We put a note on the cupboard asking everyone to use the oldest first.
examples.zh: 我们在食品柜上贴了便条，请大家「先用较早存放的食物」。

examples.en: The pantry volunteer explained what use the oldest first meant in their stock rotation system.
examples.zh: 食品救济站的志愿者解释了「先用较早存放的食物」在他们的库存周转中是什么意思。

collocations: remember to use the oldest first
a note saying use the oldest first
arrange stock to use the oldest first

words.enDefinition: To keep things in different places or containers

examples.en: We labelled the two batches that we needed to store separately in the fridge.
examples.zh: 我们给冰箱里需要「分开存放」的两批食物贴了标签。

examples.en: The label showed which parts of the meal the kitchen would store separately.
examples.zh: 标签标出了厨房会「分开存放」餐点中的哪些部分。

words.enDefinition: To freeze food in separate serving-sized amounts

examples.en: I bought smaller tubs for soup because it was easier to freeze in portions.
examples.zh: 我买了些小盒子装汤，这样更容易「分份冷冻」。

examples.en: The class discussed which foods were easy to freeze in portions at home.
examples.zh: 课堂上讨论了哪些食物在家里容易「分份冷冻」。

collocations: label foods you freeze in portions

words.enDefinition: No longer completely frozen

examples.en: The frozen berries were partially thawed by the time we unpacked the delivery.
examples.zh: 我们拆开送来的东西时，冷冻莓果已经「部分解冻」。

examples.en: I reported a partially thawed packet when I checked the supermarket delivery.
examples.zh: 检查超市送来的东西时，我反映有一包食品「部分解冻」。

words.enDefinition: Frozen completely until hard

examples.en: The soup was frozen solid when I checked the container in the drawer.
examples.zh: 我在冷冻抽屉里查看盒子时，汤已经「冻得硬邦邦的」。

examples.en: The two packs were frozen solid and stuck together in the bag.
examples.zh: 袋子里的两包东西都「冻得硬邦邦的」，还粘在了一起。

words.enDefinition: An unexpected unpleasant smell

examples.en: I noticed an off smell when I opened the carton and mentioned it to my roommate.
examples.zh: 我打开纸盒时闻到一股「异样的气味」，就告诉了室友。

examples.en: The customer described an off smell when she spoke to the shop assistant.
examples.zh: 那位顾客向店员描述了她闻到的「异样的气味」。

words.enDefinition: Food that has deteriorated and is no longer fit to eat

examples.en: The cleaning roster included a line about removing spoiled food from the shared fridge.
examples.zh: 清洁值班表上有一条是清理共用冰箱里「变质的食物」。

examples.en: We reported the spoiled food that had been left at the back of the cupboard.
examples.zh: 我们反映柜子深处留有「变质的食物」。

words.enDefinition: To store food remaining after a meal

examples.en: I stayed behind to put away the leftovers while my friends cleared the table.
examples.zh: 朋友收拾桌子时，我留下来「把剩下的饭菜收起来」。

examples.en: Could you put away the leftovers while I find the lids for these boxes?
examples.zh: 我去找这些盒子的盖子时，你能「把剩下的饭菜收起来」吗？

collocations: remember to put away the leftovers
stay to put away the leftovers

words.enDefinition: To put something back in the refrigerator

examples.en: The bottle had a note saying return to the fridge after serving.
examples.zh: 瓶子上写着，倒出需要的量后要「放回冰箱」。

examples.en: I asked which trays we needed to return to the fridge after the meeting.
examples.zh: 会后，我问哪些托盘需要「放回冰箱」。

collocations: return to the fridge after serving
remember to return to the fridge
a note saying return to the fridge

words.enDefinition: A bag lined to slow temperature changes

examples.en: I brought an insulated bag for the groceries I was carrying back on the bus.
examples.zh: 我带了个「保温袋」，装要坐公交带回去的食品。

examples.en: The shop delivered the chilled items in an insulated bag with a zip.
examples.zh: 店家用一个带拉链的「保温袋」运送冷藏食品。

collocations: carry food in an insulated bag
pack groceries in an insulated bag

words.enDefinition: A chilled or frozen pack used to keep things cool

examples.en: I found the ice pack in the bottom of the bag after the picnic.
examples.zh: 野餐结束后，我在袋底找到了「保冷冰袋」。

examples.en: The volunteer put an ice pack next to the bottles in the insulated bag.
examples.zh: 志愿者把一个「保冷冰袋」放在保温袋里的瓶子旁边。

collocations: pack drinks with an ice pack

words.enDefinition: Directions describing how to thaw frozen food

examples.en: I found thawing instructions beneath a fold at the back of the packet.
examples.zh: 我在包装背面的折边下面找到了「解冻说明」。

examples.en: The worksheet asked us to compare thawing instructions on two different food labels.
examples.zh: 练习单让我们比较两张不同食品标签上的「解冻说明」。

words.enDefinition: The surroundings needed when keeping a product

examples.en: The carton listed storage conditions beside the other information from the supplier.
examples.zh: 包装盒把「储存条件」和供应商的其他说明列在一起。

examples.en: I checked the storage conditions on the sample label before answering the question.
examples.zh: 回答问题前，我查看了标签样本上的「储存条件」。

words.enDefinition: The temperature of the air in a room

examples.en: The tea label used the phrase room temperature near the note about storage.
examples.zh: 茶叶标签在储存说明附近用了「室温」这个词。

examples.en: I noticed room temperature printed in bold at the bottom of the carton.
examples.zh: 我看到纸盒底部用粗体印着「室温」。

collocations: labeled for storage at room temperature
